strings.name: Meredith Whittaker
strings.summary: Meredith Whittaker leads Signal and is AI Now’s chief advisor. She co-founded AI Now with Kate Crawford to study AI’s social effects and power in the technology industry. She previously worked at Google, helped organize collective employee action and advised the US Federal Trade Commission chair on AI policy.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. President and CEO, appointment announcements and start dates, and release and recording dates are distinguished. Birth date remains unconfirmed.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded AI Now and participates in Signal governance, advancing debate on AI power, privacy and public-interest technology.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Bachelor of Arts in rhetoric and English literature, University of California, Berkeley.
strings.facts.f2.label: Google experience
strings.facts.f2.value: Worked there from 2006 to 2019 and founded its Open Research group.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Public-interest research
strings.highlights.h1.text: Established an interdisciplinary AI institute with Kate Crawford, addressing social effects and accountability.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Private-communication advocacy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Supports Signal’s sustainability and private communication, with a team maintaining the service.
strings.timeline.t1.title: AI-agent debate video released
strings.timeline.t1.text: Masters of Scale releases her debate with Neil Chilson on risks of giving AI agents personal information.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Burda announces board appointment
strings.timeline.t2.text: The media group announces her appointment to its board for strategic governance.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes Signal president
strings.timeline.t3.text: The September 6 announcement specifies this start date; the role is separate from CEO.
strings.timeline.t4.title: FTC announces AI advisory appointment
strings.timeline.t4.text: Appointed senior AI advisor to the chair, collaborating with policy and technology teams.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Leaves Google
strings.timeline.t5.text: A farewell letter published the next day confirms her last working day and continued AI ethics and accountability work.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Testifies before the House
strings.timeline.t6.text: Recommends oversight and whistleblower protection in testimony on AI’s social and ethical implications.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Helps organize Google walkout
strings.timeline.t7.text: Helps organize collective action seeking better harassment handling, transparency and workplace equity.
strings.timeline.t8.title: AI Now holds launch celebration
strings.timeline.t8.text: NYU celebrates the launch of the institute she co-founded with Kate Crawford.
